body:
## Summary
- Clarify that model provider credentials should be configured under `Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions` as repository secrets.
- Note that template-created repositories may automatically start setup Actions and open or update the `Sepo setup check` issue with results and next steps.
- Keep the README, docs index, and quick-start page aligned.

## Tests
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/docs-validation.test.js`

Closes #355

comments.body: actually I made a mistake. Can you keep the pointer to "Actions" but reverse all the edits on auto run of initialization action? @sepo-agent

**Sepo pushed fixes for this PR.** Branch: `agent/implement-issue-355/codex-26422873502`. Requested by @tongshuangwu.

<!-- sepo-agent-fix-pr-status -->

- Kept the `Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions` credential pointer in the README and docs.
- Restored the onboarding step to the manual `Agent / Onboarding / Check Setup` wording, removing the template auto-run/setup issue note.
- Verified with `git diff --check` and `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/docs-validation.test.js`.

## Rubrics Update

No changes were committed to [`agent/rubrics`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/tree/agent/rubrics) from PR #356.

no rubric changes

I reviewed PR #356, linked issue #355, trusted contributor signals, and existing rubrics. The maintainer feedback was trusted, but it only corrected the scope of this specific docs change and is already covered by existing rubrics around actionable setup guidance, keeping docs in sync, and surgical changes. No durable new user/team preference warranted a new or updated rubric.

title: Clarify Sepo template setup guidance
